### Connected by kindness

The Avery Dennison Foundation focuses on creating impact where it’s needed most. Through
grantmaking, we support a more thriving world. Watch our new video, illustrating how we foster a
more diverse and sustainable global community.

[Read more][157]

### Ready for what’s next. ReadyDPP™.

ReadyDPP is Avery Dennison’s integrated, full service solution that seamlessly creates and manages
Digital Product Passports. We reduce the complexity of compliance, giving you total control and
peace of mind to focus on whatever’s next for your brand.

[Learn more][158]

### Anti-dew protective overlay

Dew can cut sign reflectivity by 60% at night, risking safety. Avery Dennison OL-1200 clear overlay
film prevents dew droplets from forming, maintaining optimal visibility and sign reliability.

[Learn more][159]

## OLIN and HUNTSMAN Announce S-4 Registration Statement in Connection with Planned Merger is
## Effective

Olin Corporation (NYSE: OLN) ("Olin") and Huntsman Corporation (NYSE: HUN) ("Huntsman") announced
that on July 13, 2026, the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission declared effective the
registration statement on Form S-4 (the "Registration Statement") filed by Olin in connection with
the previously announced all-stock merger of equals (the "Transaction") to form a combined company,
OlinHuntsman. 

[Learn More][78]

## Huntsman to Discuss Second Quarter 2026 Results on July 31, 2026

We will hold a conference call on Friday, July 31, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. ET to discuss our second
quarter 2026 financial results. Following opening remarks, the call will move into a question and
answer session.

[Learn More][79]

## SHOKLESS™ systems for electric vehicle (EV) batteries
## What’s inside matters…

Developed to encapsulate EV battery cells, our portfolio of polyurethane-based SHOKLESS™ systems are
lightweight, shock-resistant, thermally optimized and structurally strong – supporting OEMs and
battery manufacturers as they work to enhance the next generation of batteries powering EVs.

[Find out more][81]

lower long-term maintenance costs.

# ABOUT SABIC

From making cars and planes more fuel-efficient, to helping conserve the world’s water supply and
enabling colorful smartphone cases, we find solutions to the challenges of today to help our
customers achieve their ambitions and build a better tomorrow.

## Our Industries

* [ [Healthcare]Hygiene & Healthcare ][173]

[OUR INDUSTRIES][177]

[A man holding looking at a tablet screen with a chart]

## Products

We gain insights by understanding our customers’ needs and use our technical expertise to tailor
solutions to help maximize their market advantage moving forward.

[OUR PRODUCTS][178]

## Sustainability

Sustainability is a vital part of our core business strategy. We're making sure we understand the
megatrends that will impact on our lives in the years to come.

[LATEST SUSTAINABILITY REPORTING][179]
[Two]

## Investors

We’re committed to long-term investments and business partnerships, by harnessing innovation,
learning and operational excellence.

[INVESTORS][180]

## CAREERS

People have helped us to develop, produce and market innovative solutions that make a difference
both to industry and to humanity. At SABIC we enable you to realize your ideas and make an impact.

[VIEW JOB OPPORTUNITIES][181]
[Three people looking at a whiteboard]
[
][182]

## Our Brand

We believe the answer to some of the world's biggest challenges lies in the natural human instinct
to collaborate. Together we're making Chemistry that Matters™.

[Our Brand][183]

## Our Stories

For over 45 years, our ambition to define the future of petrochemicals has yielded solutions for the
challenges of today and helped our customers achieve their ambitions for a better tomorrow. We are
making a meaningful impact in the world and delivering Chemistry that Matters™.

[Read our stories][184]

# ABOUT SABIC

From making cars and planes more fuel-efficient, to helping conserve the world’s water supply and
enabling colorful smartphone cases, we find solutions to the challenges of today to help our
customers achieve their ambitions and build a better tomorrow.

## Our Industries
* [ [agriculture]Agriculture ][168]
* [ [automotice]Automotive ][169]

* [ [Healthcare]Hygiene & Healthcare ][173]
* [ [Industrial]Industrial ][174]
* [ [Mass]Mass Transportation ][175]
* [ [Packaging]Packaging ][176]

[OUR INDUSTRIES][177]

[A man holding looking at a tablet screen with a chart]

## Products

We gain insights by understanding our customers’ needs and use our technical expertise to tailor
solutions to help maximize their market advantage moving forward.

[OUR PRODUCTS][178]

## Sustainability

Sustainability is a vital part of our core business strategy. We're making sure we understand the
megatrends that will impact on our lives in the years to come.

[LATEST SUSTAINABILITY REPORTING][179]
[Two]

## Investors

We’re committed to long-term investments and business partnerships, by harnessing innovation,
learning and operational excellence.

[INVESTORS][180]

## CAREERS

People have helped us to develop, produce and market innovative solutions that make a difference
both to industry and to humanity. At SABIC we enable you to realize your ideas and make an impact.

[VIEW JOB OPPORTUNITIES][181]
[Three people looking at a whiteboard]
[
][182]

## Our Brand

We believe the answer to some of the world's biggest challenges lies in the natural human instinct
to collaborate. Together we're making Chemistry that Matters™.

[Our Brand][183]

## Our Stories

For over 45 years, our ambition to define the future of petrochemicals has yielded solutions for the
challenges of today and helped our customers achieve their ambitions for a better tomorrow. We are
making a meaningful impact in the world and delivering Chemistry that Matters™.

[Read our stories][184]

Creating sustainable impact

## For Generations

"For Generations" signifies our dedication to acting responsibly today to ensure a positive legacy
for those who come after us. Building on our process expertise and on our core beliefs, this program
is designed to foster trust and create value for Solvay, its stakeholders, and society as a whole. 
[Learn about the program][91]
[AIR Cover_1022x506px - 1]

## Annual Integrated Report

In 2025, Solvay delivered on its commitment to excellence in both financial and sustainability
performance despite a macroeconomic environment marked by geopolitical and  economic uncertainties. 

[Read our latest Annual Report][92]
[Solvay employees in France]

## Join our team and thrive

We actively seek employees whose personal values resonate with ours, as this alignment is integral
to fulfilling our mission. The journey begins with a steadfast commitment to our company’s core
values and purpose. We are essential chemistry, making progress possible for generations.

 

[Discover Life at Solvay][93]

## We are essential chemistry, making progress possible for generations.

Solvay, a pioneering chemical company with a legacy rooted in founder Ernest Solvay's pivotal
innovations in the soda ash process, is dedicated to delivering essential solutions globally through
its workforce of around 9,000 employees. Since 1863, Solvay harnesses the power of chemistry to
create innovative, sustainable solutions that answer the world’s most essential needs such as
purifying the air we breathe and the water we use, preserving our food supplies, protecting our
health and well-being, creating eco-friendly clothing, making the tires of our cars more sustainable
and cleaning and protecting our homes. Solvay’s unwavering commitment drives the transition to a
carbon-neutral future by 2050, underscoring its dedication to sustainability and a fair and just
transition. As a world-leading company with €4.7 billion in underlying net sales in 2024, Solvay is
listed on Euronext Brussels and Paris (SOLB).

## For Generations

"For Generations" signifies our dedication to acting responsibly today to ensure a positive legacy
for those who come after us. Building on our process expertise and on our core beliefs, this program
is designed to foster trust and create value for Solvay, its stakeholders, and society as a whole.

In 2025, Solvay delivered on its commitment to excellence in both financial and sustainability
performance despite a macroeconomic environment marked by geopolitical and  economic uncertainties.

## Join our team and thrive

We actively seek employees whose personal values resonate with ours, as this alignment is integral
to fulfilling our mission. The journey begins with a steadfast commitment to our company’s core
values and purpose. We are essential chemistry, making progress possible for generations.

 

[Discover Life at Solvay][93]

## We are essential chemistry, making progress possible for generations.

Solvay, a pioneering chemical company with a legacy rooted in founder Ernest Solvay's pivotal
innovations in the soda ash process, is dedicated to delivering essential solutions globally through
its workforce of around 9,000 employees. Since 1863, Solvay harnesses the power of chemistry to
create innovative, sustainable solutions that answer the world’s most essential needs such as
purifying the air we breathe and the water we use, preserving our food supplies, protecting our
health and well-being, creating eco-friendly clothing, making the tires of our cars more sustainable
and cleaning and protecting our homes. Solvay’s unwavering commitment drives the transition to a
carbon-neutral future by 2050, underscoring its dedication to sustainability and a fair and just
transition. As a world-leading company with €4.7 billion in underlying net sales in 2024, Solvay is
listed on Euronext Brussels and Paris (SOLB).

## Innovative solutions
## to improve polymer performance

**We enhance the performance of polymers.**

Improved processing, durability, esthetic and performance: ADEKA Polymer Additives Europe offers
innovative solutions that enhance the performance of polymers throughout their entire life cycle.

You can rely on our best-in-class commodity and specialty additives as well as our formulations to
fulfil your evolving needs.

Our state-of-the-art technologies create high value for customers. By achieving energy efficiency,
lowering manufacturing costs, and reducing environmental footprint: our extensive range of additives
helps plastics producers develop new design solutions and unlock market opportunities.

## ADEKA CONTRIBUTING
## TO A SUSTAINABLE FUTURE

Around 350 million tons of plastic waste are produced each year, yet only approximately 10 percent
is recycled. One reason is that there is no “one-size-fits-all” solution.

A variety of recycling approaches is required to achieve circularity. In the coming years,
sustainable practices and waste management will increasingly rely on various recycling technologies.
Rather than competing, these technologies collaborate to improve efficiency.

As mechanical recycling methods approach their limits for certain waste streams, the significance of
chemical recycling pathways increases, ensuring that every opportunity for circularity is utilized.
This is why ADEKA Polymer Additives Europe advocates for all forms of recycling technologies.

## Sustainability statement
## and lifecycle approach

Through innovation, we offer sustainable products and solutions that assist customers in addressing
challenges related to design, performance, recycling, and lifecycle of plastics. ADEKA conducts Life
Cycle Assessments (LCAs) of its products to support a circular economy and advance design for
circularity while supporting mechanical recycling.

ADEKA’s success is driven by agile global processes, a wide range of high-performance products, and
skilled teams who actively manage challenges.

Sustainability is a collective responsibility engaging our global workforce.

We continually develop environmentally friendly solutions aligned with ethical standards, minimizing
waste, using improved materials, reducing packaging, and providing greater value for customers.

The global ADEKA team is dedicated to leveraging its expertise for the benefit of customers. By
generating sustainable value through innovation, we assist customers in overcoming challenges and
gaining competitive advantage. Consequently, ADEKA’s operations adopt an agile, market-focused
approach to meet evolving industry needs.
* Discover [our solutions][73]
* Contact [our team][74] to learn how ADEKA can support your polymer innovation.

## Innovative solutions
## to improve polymer performance

**We enhance the performance of polymers.**

Improved processing, durability, esthetic and performance: ADEKA Polymer Additives Europe offers
innovative solutions that enhance the performance of polymers throughout their entire life cycle.

You can rely on our best-in-class commodity and specialty additives as well as our formulations to
fulfil your evolving needs.

Our state-of-the-art technologies create high value for customers. By achieving energy efficiency,
lowering manufacturing costs, and reducing environmental footprint: our extensive range of additives
helps plastics producers develop new design solutions and unlock market opportunities.

## ADEKA CONTRIBUTING
## TO A SUSTAINABLE FUTURE

Around 350 million tons of plastic waste are produced each year, yet only approximately 10 percent
is recycled. One reason is that there is no “one-size-fits-all” solution.

A variety of recycling approaches is required to achieve circularity. In the coming years,
sustainable practices and waste management will increasingly rely on various recycling technologies.
Rather than competing, these technologies collaborate to improve efficiency.

As mechanical recycling methods approach their limits for certain waste streams, the significance of
chemical recycling pathways increases, ensuring that every opportunity for circularity is utilized.
This is why ADEKA Polymer Additives Europe advocates for all forms of recycling technologies.

## Sustainability statement
## and lifecycle approach

Through innovation, we offer sustainable products and solutions that assist customers in addressing
challenges related to design, performance, recycling, and lifecycle of plastics. ADEKA conducts Life
Cycle Assessments (LCAs) of its products to support a circular economy and advance design for
circularity while supporting mechanical recycling.

ADEKA’s success is driven by agile global processes, a wide range of high-performance products, and
skilled teams who actively manage challenges.

Sustainability is a collective responsibility engaging our global workforce.

We continually develop environmentally friendly solutions aligned with ethical standards, minimizing
waste, using improved materials, reducing packaging, and providing greater value for customers.

The global ADEKA team is dedicated to leveraging its expertise for the benefit of customers. By
generating sustainable value through innovation, we assist customers in overcoming challenges and
gaining competitive advantage. Consequently, ADEKA’s operations adopt an agile, market-focused
approach to meet evolving industry needs.
* Discover [our solutions][73]
* Contact [our team][74] to learn how ADEKA can support your polymer innovation.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Common questions about CheckerTR PRO Android service software and licensing.

### What is CheckerTR PRO?

CheckerTR PRO is an all-in-one GSM repair toolkit for professional technicians. It covers IMEI
repair, FRP bypass, data recovery, and flashing for most Android brands.

### Which brands are supported?

We support Samsung, Xiaomi, MediaTek, Qualcomm, Huawei, Oppo, Realme, Infinix, Tecno, and many other
brands with dedicated service modules.

### How can I get a license?

Licenses and credits are sold through our official reseller network. Check our [Authorized
Resellers][49] page for a distributor in your region.

### How Omega-3 Free Fatty Acids Improve Absorption

AvailOm^{®} from Evonik delivers EPA and DHA as free fatty acids in a solid omega-3 lysine complex,
the form that is absorbed most efficiently.
[Read Article][123]

### The Role of Potassium Iodide as a Dietary Supplement

Potassium iodide (KI) is one of the most widely used and bioavailable forms of iodine
supplementation, providing a safe and reliable source of iodine ions for a wide range of nutritional
applications.
[Read Article][124]

### Bostik PURELAM™ and PURETHANE™ Laminating Adhesives

Bostik PURELAM™ and PURETHANE™ laminating adhesives deliver fast cure, high line speeds, and
reliable performance for flexible packaging applications.
[Read Article][125]

### Lubrication Troubleshooting Playbook: Symptoms, Causes, and Fixes

Sourcing is not just about getting lubricants in stock. It is about helping maintenance standardize
the use of the right lubricant for the operating conditions, material set, failure mode, and
maintenance interval.
[Read Article][126]

### What Is N,N-Dimethylacetoacetamide (DMAA)?

What is DMAA? Learn how N,N-dimethylacetoacetamide functions as a resin copromoter and chemical
intermediate for coatings, polymers, and synthesis.
[Read Article][127]

### Application Lab Testing for Camlin Fine Sciences Antioxidants

Camlin Fine Sciences (CFS) operates a dedicated Customer Application Lab staffed with technical
experts who evaluate, validate, and fine-tune antioxidant performance in your system.
[Read Article][128]

### Eastman - Role of Triethyl Phosphate in PVC

Discover how triethyl phosphate enhances PVC flexibility and fire resistance as a co-plasticizer and
flame-retardant. Request an Eastman TEP sample today!
[Read Article][129]

### DOWFROST™ LC for Data Center Liquid Cooling

DOWFROST™ LC is an inhibited propylene glycol-based heat transfer fluid designed specifically for
liquid cooling systems where thermal performance, corrosion protection, freeze protection, and
system compatibility are critical. Its primary applications in data center environments are
Direct-to-Chip cooling and support for in-rack closed-loop and in-row close-coupled cooling systems.

Where biotech companies are launched and products manufactured on the same linearly scalable

Join us in the world we are making where clinical nutrition and medicine are reimagined-advancing

[ JOURNEY WITH US ][64]

Bioinnovation Venture Accelerator Bridging the translation Gap: Idea to Exit


Esco Aster is a biotech factory helping to spin out our existing Tide Motion bioprocess products
and/or services with the fastest time to clinic, using our standardized, linearly scalable
biomanufacturing platforms that are globally investable and backed by an exit strategy ensuring
returns to all stakeholders — from the public, founders, foundations, and nonprofits to financial
investors.

[ JOURNEY WITH US ][65]

cGMP CRDMO


cGMP-integrated contract research, development, and manufacturing organization. Esco Aster operates
two dedicated certified sites: one focused on clinical medicine, veterinary medicine, and
dermocosmetics; the other focused on clinical cell-based and derivative nutrition, and
nutricosmetics.

[ JOURNEY WITH US ][66]

Advancing the Future of Medicine Through Innovation


At Esco Aster, we empower the development of next-generation medicines by combining advanced
bioprocess solutions, translational research, and scalable manufacturing support. From discovery to
commercialization, we help innovators accelerate breakthroughs in biologics, cell and gene therapy,
vaccines, and regenerative medicine.

[ JOURNEY WITH US ][67]

Enabling Next-Generation Clinical Nutritional Solutions


Esco Aster provides cell-based products and derivatives for clinical and functional nutrition. These
include cell-based meats, proteins, fatty acids, collagen, and other high-value ingredients such as
bird’s nest, deer antler, mitochondria, and milk-/plant-derived extracellular vesicles for
nutraceuticals and supplements.

These products are developed for both companion animals and humans, ensuring clinical benefits for
improved skin health and gut microbiome function. This enables precision nutrition for cancer
patients as well as wellness and longevity applications aimed at increasing health span, not just
lifespan.

# A sustainable future through innovative chemistry

##### Our vision is to become a sustainable world-class specialty chemicals company

With a vision to become a sustainable world-class specialty chemicals company, we deliver customer
value through innovative chemistry that supports the energy transition and drives sustainable
progress.

Our specialty chemicals reduce the impact of current transportation modes, enable e-mobility,
support decarbonisation, improve industrial efficiency and much more, helping our customers solve
complex challenges and succeed in a changing world.

### Customer Centric Innovation

We provide innovative solutions that solve the complex challenges faced by our customers today

[Explore our Customer Centric Innovation][48]

### Sustainability

Working with our value chain partners to achieve sustainability ambitions

[Learn about our Sustainability approach][49]

### Safety

Safety, Security and the Environment are our highest priorities

[Safety is our number one priority][50]

[[Application introduction of Paints]][208]
[Introduction of applications: Paint][209]

In general, Paint refers to Powder coating paint, Emulsion paint or Solvent based paint (oil
vanish). 

[more][210]
[[Pearl luster Printing Ink]][211]
[Introduction of applications: Pearl luster Printing Ink][212]

Pearly luster printing ink is becoming popular. Pearly-luster printing ink uses a special
pearlescent pigment that is different from metal pigment and helps to save costs. This is why the
demand for pearly-luster printing ink is growing.

[more][213]
[[Special Effect Color Masterbatch]][214]
[Introduction Of Applications: Plastics][215]

You can find almost all of these special effect pigments used in the plastics industry at iSuoChem.
We'll list some of these effect pigments in the next article for your reference.

[more][216]
[[effect pigment for ceramics]][217]
[Special effect pigment for ceramics][218]

iSuoChem® effect pigment is widely used in ceramic glaze, enamel wares, glass and glassware
decorations. Pearl pigment and glitter powder can be used as overglaze color. Thermochromic pigment
is to be used in mug or ceramic wares and makes the color changing by temperature.

[more][219]
[[Pigments for Decoration]][220]
[Introduction of applications: Effect Pigments for Decoration][221]

Why decoration? It is human nature to pursue beauty, and it will never stop. Beauty makes people
have a more positive attitude towards life. When people have safe living space and enough food, they
probably want to decorate their rooms, beautify their appearance, decorate their working space and
social public environment. In short, people want to make life beautiful, so decoration becomes
necessary daily need.

[more][222]
[[Cosmetics Effect pigment]][223]
[Special effect pigment for cosmetics][224]

iSuoChem® cosmetic grade pearl pigment is strictly following International regulation on chemistry,
heavy metal and micro-biology. It is safe for human body and is able to enhance your beauty.

[more][225]
[[Pigment for Repair Paint]][226]
[Various Effect Pigment for Repair Paint][227]

iSuoChem can supply various effect pigment, Like Pearl pigment, Chameleon pigment, glitter powder,
Glow pigment and many other effect pigment to mix with paint as Car Repair paint.

[more][228]
[[Effect pigment for paper & card]][229]
[Introduction of applications: Paper & Cards][230]

When you need a complete solution for printing on paper & cards, feel free to contact iSuoChem's
team and you can get full support on the first time.

[more][231]
[[Pearl pigment for leather]][232]
[Introduction of applications: Pearlescent Leather][233]

Pearl leather has a softer look and more subtle sheen than normal leather. In comparison, our
Pearlessence leather has a specially formulated finish with a pearl pigment. This combination pearl
finish provides superior durability and increased water resistance.

[more][234]
[[Pigment for textile printing]][235]
[Introduction of applications: Textiles][236]

Textile printing technology is based on a variety of ink resins as the carrier, composed of effect
pigments or dyes and related additives, with good adhesion. By different printing methods, words and
drawings are printed on textile fabrics.

[Introduction of applications: Paint][209]

In general, Paint refers to Powder coating paint, Emulsion paint or Solvent based paint (oil
vanish). 

[more][210]
[[Pearl luster Printing Ink]][211]
[Introduction of applications: Pearl luster Printing Ink][212]

Pearly luster printing ink is becoming popular. Pearly-luster printing ink uses a special
pearlescent pigment that is different from metal pigment and helps to save costs. This is why the
demand for pearly-luster printing ink is growing.

[more][213]
[[Special Effect Color Masterbatch]][214]
[Introduction Of Applications: Plastics][215]

You can find almost all of these special effect pigments used in the plastics industry at iSuoChem.
We'll list some of these effect pigments in the next article for your reference.

[more][216]
[[effect pigment for ceramics]][217]
[Special effect pigment for ceramics][218]

iSuoChem® effect pigment is widely used in ceramic glaze, enamel wares, glass and glassware
decorations. Pearl pigment and glitter powder can be used as overglaze color. Thermochromic pigment
is to be used in mug or ceramic wares and makes the color changing by temperature.

[more][219]
[[Pigments for Decoration]][220]
[Introduction of applications: Effect Pigments for Decoration][221]

Why decoration? It is human nature to pursue beauty, and it will never stop. Beauty makes people
have a more positive attitude towards life. When people have safe living space and enough food, they
probably want to decorate their rooms, beautify their appearance, decorate their working space and
social public environment. In short, people want to make life beautiful, so decoration becomes
necessary daily need.

[more][222]
[[Cosmetics Effect pigment]][223]
[Special effect pigment for cosmetics][224]

iSuoChem® cosmetic grade pearl pigment is strictly following International regulation on chemistry,
heavy metal and micro-biology. It is safe for human body and is able to enhance your beauty.

[more][225]
[[Pigment for Repair Paint]][226]
[Various Effect Pigment for Repair Paint][227]

iSuoChem can supply various effect pigment, Like Pearl pigment, Chameleon pigment, glitter powder,
Glow pigment and many other effect pigment to mix with paint as Car Repair paint.

[more][228]
[[Effect pigment for paper & card]][229]
[Introduction of applications: Paper & Cards][230]

When you need a complete solution for printing on paper & cards, feel free to contact iSuoChem's
team and you can get full support on the first time.

[more][231]
[[Pearl pigment for leather]][232]
[Introduction of applications: Pearlescent Leather][233]

Pearl leather has a softer look and more subtle sheen than normal leather. In comparison, our
Pearlessence leather has a specially formulated finish with a pearl pigment. This combination pearl
finish provides superior durability and increased water resistance.

[more][234]
[[Pigment for textile printing]][235]
[Introduction of applications: Textiles][236]

Textile printing technology is based on a variety of ink resins as the carrier, composed of effect
pigments or dyes and related additives, with good adhesion. By different printing methods, words and
drawings are printed on textile fabrics.

From gripping horror to dynamic action, strategic puzzles, and innovative educational games, our
catalog spans numerous genres to suit every gamer’s preference.

[Among Us][87]: Strategic Social Deduction

Among Us, a game that has transcended its indie roots to become a global phenomenon, offers a
thrilling multiplayer experience. Players are thrown into a spaceship as crew members, where they
must work together to identify the impostors sabotaging their survival. It’s a test of deception and
detection, making for exciting and unpredictable gameplay sessions.

[That’s Not My Neighbor][88]

That’s Not My Neighbor turns a quaint neighborhood into a scene of mystery and danger. Players
investigate their surroundings, solve puzzles, and uncover the sinister realities hiding in plain
sight. This game mixes narrative-driven exploration with elements of horror, delivering a chilling
experience.

[Buckshot Roulette][89]: Quick Reflex Challenges

Buckshot Roulette offers fast-paced action with a simple yet addictive mechanic. Players navigate
through perilous levels where timing and precision are crucial. The game’s intuitive design and
escalating difficulty provide a compelling challenge for fans of skill-based games.

Baldi’s Basics Plus: Educational and Eerie

Baldi’s Basics Plus creatively blends educational challenges with light-hearted horror. Players
solve math problems and navigate through school-themed levels while avoiding the increasingly
strange behaviors of Baldi. The game’s unique approach to the horror and educational genre makes it
stand out as both entertaining and unnerving.

Night of the Consumers: Retail Horror

grotesquely exaggerated supermarket where the customers literally are your worst nightmare. This
game is a thrilling survival horror experience with satirical undertones, focusing on the challenges

experience.

## Products

[BioLoop Surfactants]

#### BioLoops
####  

For many years we have been exploring the concept of engineering new surfactants using novel
bio-based technologies. Sustainable products from renewable sources have been around for many years,
but the majority have very limited functionality in terms of performance compared to synthetic
countertypes. Our remit was to develop a range of biobased products that offer comparable
performance against the synthetic products across many applications.

[More Details][26]
[Anionic-Surfactants]

#### Anionics
####  

Anionic surfactants are negatively charged materials that are available in a variety of chemical
types. The main classes being alkyl ether sulfates, alkyl sulfates, alkylbenzene sulfonates, alpha
olefin sulfonates, phosphate esters. They are used in a wide range of applications where they
provide useful characteristics including, emulsification, solubilisation, wetting, detergency,
dispersion and foaming.



[More Details][27]
[Nonionic Surfactants]

#### Nonionics


Nonionic surfactants carry no electrical charge and are available in a variety of chemical types.
The main classes are alcohol ethoxylates, alcohol ethoxylates/propoxylates, ethylene oxide-propylene
oxide copolymers, castor oil ethoxylates, amine ethoxylates, fatty acid esters and their
ethoxylates. They are used in a wide range of applications where they provide useful characteristics
including  emulsification, solubilisation, wetting, dispersion, detergency, foaming and defoaming.

[More Details][28]
[Amphoteric & Cationic Surfactants]

#### Amphoteric & Cationic 

Amphoteric surfactants can carry a positive or negative charge depending on pH, whereas cationic
surfactants carry a positive charge. There are a number of chemical types for amphoteric surfactants
including betaines, amidopropyl betaines, alkylamino dipropionates. They are used in a wide range of
applications where they provide useful characteristics such as foaming, solubilisation, antistatic.




[More Details][29]

## Meet the BioLoop Family — Soybean, Sunflower & Rapeseed Variants

][40]
Meet the BioLoop Family—Lankem’s innovative range of bio-based surfactants derived from soybean,
sunflower, and rapeseed oils. With over 98% renewable carbon content, BioLoop surfactants deliver
excellent detergency, wetting, foaming control, mildness, and formulation flexibility without
compromising performance. Discover how this sustainable technology is helping formulators reduce
reliance on fossil-based ingredients across industrial, consumer, coatings, and personal care
[Reformulating Around the LAB Squeeze ][Reformulating Around the LAB Squeeze ]
[

## Reformulating Around the LAB Squeeze

][41]
With LAB supply tight and DDBSA prices rising, Kemsurf SBE30 (LAS) is under pressure. Kemsurf OS38
(AOS) is built on a different alpha-olefin feedstock — sidestepping the bottleneck while matching or
beating SBE30 across most sectors: higher, more stable foam, superior hard-water tolerance, better
mildness, stronger cold-wash performance and ready biodegradability. From laundry and dishwash to
personal care and firefighting foams, OS38 isn't a fallback — it's an upgrade.
[Lankem's SOUNDS FOOD Project][Lankem's SOUNDS FOOD Project]
[

## Introducing the SOUNDS FOOD Project: Ultrasonic Cleaning Meets Bio-based Chemistry

][42]
Discover the SOUNDS FOOD project, where ultrasonic cleaning technology and Lankem's BioLoop
bio-based surfactants are helping reduce water, energy and chemical use in food and beverage
cleaning applications.
[Aqueous White Dispersions][Aqueous White Dispersions]
[

## Conventional Technology for Aqueous White Dispersions

][43]
This study explores how different dispersants influence the quality and stability of aqueous
titanium dioxide dispersions. Comparing a market‑standard polyacrylate with Lankem’s Lansperse SPA
and DS80, results show significant improvements in particle size, viscosity control, and storage
stability—especially with the high‑performing Lansperse DS80.
[Aqueous White Dispersions][Aqueous White Dispersions]
[

## BioLoop Technology for Aqueous White Dispersions

][44]
Following a laboratory study by Lankem into the performance of bio-based dispersants in aqueous
dispersions of titanium dioxide pigment, two products were shown to give excellent performance in
comparison to a conventional sodium polyacrylate dispersant.

## Meet the BioLoop Family — Soybean, Sunflower & Rapeseed Variants

][40]
Meet the BioLoop Family—Lankem’s innovative range of bio-based surfactants derived from soybean,
sunflower, and rapeseed oils. With over 98% renewable carbon content, BioLoop surfactants deliver
excellent detergency, wetting, foaming control, mildness, and formulation flexibility without
compromising performance. Discover how this sustainable technology is helping formulators reduce
reliance on fossil-based ingredients across industrial, consumer, coatings, and personal care
[Reformulating Around the LAB Squeeze ][Reformulating Around the LAB Squeeze ]
[

## Reformulating Around the LAB Squeeze

][41]
With LAB supply tight and DDBSA prices rising, Kemsurf SBE30 (LAS) is under pressure. Kemsurf OS38
(AOS) is built on a different alpha-olefin feedstock — sidestepping the bottleneck while matching or
beating SBE30 across most sectors: higher, more stable foam, superior hard-water tolerance, better
mildness, stronger cold-wash performance and ready biodegradability. From laundry and dishwash to
personal care and firefighting foams, OS38 isn't a fallback — it's an upgrade.

## Introducing the SOUNDS FOOD Project: Ultrasonic Cleaning Meets Bio-based Chemistry

][42]
Discover the SOUNDS FOOD project, where ultrasonic cleaning technology and Lankem's BioLoop
bio-based surfactants are helping reduce water, energy and chemical use in food and beverage
cleaning applications.

## Conventional Technology for Aqueous White Dispersions

][43]
This study explores how different dispersants influence the quality and stability of aqueous
titanium dioxide dispersions. Comparing a market‑standard polyacrylate with Lankem’s Lansperse SPA
and DS80, results show significant improvements in particle size, viscosity control, and storage
stability—especially with the high‑performing Lansperse DS80.

## BioLoop Technology for Aqueous White Dispersions

][44]
Following a laboratory study by Lankem into the performance of bio-based dispersants in aqueous
dispersions of titanium dioxide pigment, two products were shown to give excellent performance in
comparison to a conventional sodium polyacrylate dispersant.

### What is a KBA number?

KBA-Nr. until 2005

[hsntsn_01_1_]

.

[hsntsn_02]

KBA-Nr. from 2005

[hsntsn_03]

The KBA number, also known as the key number, is a unique number under which a vehicle type is
registered with the Federal Motor Transport Authority. By searching via the KBA number, you can be
sure that it is exactly your vehicle type. You will find the KBA number in fields 2 and 3 of the

### What is a KBA number?

KBA-Nr. until 2005

[hsntsn_01_1_]

.

[hsntsn_02]

KBA-Nr. from 2005

[hsntsn_03]

The KBA number, also known as the key number, is a unique number under which a vehicle type is
registered with the Federal Motor Transport Authority. By searching via the KBA number, you can be
sure that it is exactly your vehicle type. You will find the KBA number in fields 2 and 3 of the
vehicle registration certificate or in the registration certificate part 1 under 2.1. and 2.2.

## Do you really know who you’re dealing with?

We enter into contracts with companies every day. Each of those contracts was with something with
legal personality – almost always a "legal entity". Yet too often we're ignorant of them and who is
behind them, with all the attendant risks that brings.

Whether you're in business, government, journalism, activism, research or a consumer — [our
goal][39] is to help you better understand the companies you deal with.

Search the world’s largest open legal-entity database or plug the data direct into your applications
and processes.

Fresh, standardized, auditable information underpinned by our [Legal-Entity Data Principles][40],
this is data you can trust.

And yet it is. Legal-entity information is dispersed across hundreds of business registers that are

## OpenCorporates was born out of the same frustrations you experience every day

We believe a fairer, more prosperous and sustainable society can only be achieved with greater
corporate transparency.

Since 2010 we’ve been working with government agencies, NGOs and public-benefit groups to improve
the quality and accessibility of the foundational legal-entity data on which you depend.

Today we offer the world's largest open legal-entity database, providing a single unified set of 
company records from over 140 government registries and other official sources around the world.

Whether you're in business, government, journalism, activism, research or a consumer — [our

## It shouldn't be hard to get legal-entity data you can trust

And yet it is. Legal-entity information is dispersed across hundreds of business registers that are
hard to navigate and impossible to access at scale. Traditional company-data aggregators are no
longer the answer either, given their opaque processes and provenance.

Verifiable accuracy is more important than ever, and you should expect more.

You need data built on deep expertise, rigorous data models and [well-founded, forward-looking
principles][43]. Data sourced direct from primary sources, curated with clear decision-making and no
hidden bias, and defined by open not proprietary identifiers and standards. Data you know you can
trust.

## OpenCorporates was born out of the same frustrations you experience every day

We believe a fairer, more prosperous and sustainable society can only be achieved with greater
corporate transparency.

Since 2010 we’ve been working with government agencies, NGOs and public-benefit groups to improve
the quality and accessibility of the foundational legal-entity data on which you depend.

Today we offer the world's largest open legal-entity database, providing a single unified set of 
company records from over 140 government registries and other official sources around the world.

### [Rickman Antifoam Manufacturer][194]

At RICKMAN, we create defoamer chemistry for a better and more sustainable future.
Rickman was found in 2013, engaged in production, research and development, sales and service of
defoamer.
With professional knowledge, rich experience, and the concept of innovation and development, Rickman
owns a mature technical team and advanced production equipment.
The mainly products include defoamer, fungicide scale inhibitor and other products’ series.
The comprehensive annual capacity can reach 30,000 tons. These products are widely used in pulp and
paper, textile, industrial water treatment, paint and ink, oil and gas, agriculture, food,
fermentation, industrial cleaning, metal processing and other fields.
We believe that our mission is to work closely with our customers, providing them with antifoaming
agent solutions enable them to deliver their potential.







**Why Choose Rickman **[**Defoamer Manufacturer**][195]**?**





### **1. Research and Development**

### Rickman set up an engineering technology center, who is responsible for defoamer and antifoam
### research and development technology. Our technical team is committed to developing new different
### defoamer solutions to meet any challenges of our partners and customers.
### 
### 
### 



### **2. Production Capacity**

Annual production capacity is 30,000 tons. The quality of foam control agents is essential to our co
mpany. As defoamer  manufacturer, there is a mature quality inspection procedures to ensure
quality of antifoam compliance with standard.




### 

### **3. ****Supply Channel**

Rickman provides service for all over the world with technical support and abundant experience in
customer service.














** Rickman Main**[**Anti foams**][196]



### [Silicone Defoamer][197]

Silicone antifoam is polysiloxanes as the primary active substance defoamer, with a particularly low
surface tension. In foam problem, it offers highly effective antifoaming and foam control solutions
in textile, pulp and paper, water treatment, oil and gas, construction metalworking liquid and other
industries.



### [Fatty Alcohol Defoamer][198]

Fatty alcohol defoamer is a type silicone free defoamer prepared from high grade fatty alcohol as
the main active substance , which is mainly used in eliminating and control foam in paper making
white water wet end and water treatment  and other industries and processes.



### [Polyether Defoamer][199]

Polyether defoamer is a non-silicon defoamer mainly composed of modified polyether. It has the
characteristics of good dispersibility in water and strong dynamic antifoaming ability. It is mainly
used in paper process, oil and gas, alumina, power plant desulfurization, fermentation, water
treatment , industrial cleaning and other industries.



### [Powder Defoamer][200]

Powdered, silicone and silicone free antifoam is designed to degassing air and control foam in
aqueous systems such as food processing, dry cement mortar, oil drilling ,water treatment, and other
processes.



[**Defoamer compoun**][201]d

   Experience the power of our Antifoam Compound as it breaks the surface tension of liquids,
liberating trapped gas bubbles with ease. It provides a clear path for unhindered progress, paving
the way for seamless operations and enhanced productivity.



### [Mineral Oil Defoamer][202]

Most mineral oil antifoam is prepared by the large coefficient of osmosis of mineral oil and
hydrophobic particles as antifoaming active material, supplemented by antifoaming synergistic
substance.















**Our Purpose**

To solve foam problem and improve efficiency through antifoam solutions.



**Our Vision**

To be the global leader in antifoam innovation and build a safer, healthier,  more sustainable
world.



**Mission**

We strive to build a better and more sustainable world with our partners by solving chemistry
problems with the right technology, experience and team.

Rickman was found in 2013, engaged in production, research and development, sales and service of

With professional knowledge, rich experience, and the concept of innovation and development, Rickman
owns a mature technical team and advanced production equipment.
The mainly products include defoamer, fungicide scale inhibitor and other products’ series.
The comprehensive annual capacity can reach 30,000 tons. These products are widely used in pulp and
paper, textile, industrial water treatment, paint and ink, oil and gas, agriculture, food,
fermentation, industrial cleaning, metal processing and other fields.
We believe that our mission is to work closely with our customers, providing them with antifoaming
agent solutions enable them to deliver their potential.

quality of antifoam compliance with standard.

### **3. ****Supply Channel**

** Rickman Main**[**Anti foams**][196]



### [Silicone Defoamer][197]

Silicone antifoam is polysiloxanes as the primary active substance defoamer, with a particularly low
surface tension. In foam problem, it offers highly effective antifoaming and foam control solutions
in textile, pulp and paper, water treatment, oil and gas, construction metalworking liquid and other
industries.



### [Fatty Alcohol Defoamer][198]

Fatty alcohol defoamer is a type silicone free defoamer prepared from high grade fatty alcohol as
the main active substance , which is mainly used in eliminating and control foam in paper making
white water wet end and water treatment  and other industries and processes.



### [Polyether Defoamer][199]

Polyether defoamer is a non-silicon defoamer mainly composed of modified polyether. It has the
characteristics of good dispersibility in water and strong dynamic antifoaming ability. It is mainly
used in paper process, oil and gas, alumina, power plant desulfurization, fermentation, water
treatment , industrial cleaning and other industries.



### [Powder Defoamer][200]

Powdered, silicone and silicone free antifoam is designed to degassing air and control foam in
aqueous systems such as food processing, dry cement mortar, oil drilling ,water treatment, and other
processes.

   Experience the power of our Antifoam Compound as it breaks the surface tension of liquids,
liberating trapped gas bubbles with ease. It provides a clear path for unhindered progress, paving
the way for seamless operations and enhanced productivity.



### [Mineral Oil Defoamer][202]

Most mineral oil antifoam is prepared by the large coefficient of osmosis of mineral oil and
hydrophobic particles as antifoaming active material, supplemented by antifoaming synergistic
substance.

All product data for your industry vertical, advanced search capacities and direct contact with
suppliers. All in one place. FOR FREE
[Example Image]
INDUSTRY MASTER CATALOG

### Search a catalog that you can trust

SpecialChem maintains the global master catalogs for the following five industry verticals: adhesive
ingredients, coating ingredients, cosmetic ingredients, plastics and elastomers, and polymer
additives. These master catalogs include all products from all suppliers worldwide, making it the
most comprehensive resource available. Product data is sourced directly from manufacturers and
updated daily. Behind the scenes, several dozen chemical experts systematically review every
product, monitor each new release, and track the latest mergers and acquisitions. This ongoing work
ensures that you always have access to the most accurate, up-to-date, and reliable information—so
you can make confident decisions, faster.
[Example Image]
UNIQUE SEARCH CAPACITIES

### Find your products, no matter your criteria

Whether you know exactly what you need, or have rather loose criteria, you can find your way within
SpecialChem master catalogs. Drill down products using up-to 15 dimensions, compare grades, and even
search on a graph! SpecialChem standardizes product data provided by material suppliers, turning it
into convenient filters and search modes. If you need a bit more guidance to achieve a certain
requirement, we can support your material discovery with formalized industry know-how validated by
technical experts.
[Example Image]
CONNECT WITH SUPPLIERS

### Connect with suppliers to get specific recommendations

Hundreds of suppliers are just a click away on the SpecialChem platform. Avoid sending desperate
contact us form into the void. We will connect you with the teams that are truly in charge of the
product portfolio. We know the importance of getting reliable product recommendations to advance
your project.
[Example Image]
GET SAMPLES

### Get samples in few clicks

Tens of thousands of chemicals, ingredients, and materials are available with a sampling option. In
just a few clicks, your sample order is on its way to the supplier. This guarantees you can quickly
resume your product development work. More and more producers and distributors are offering this
option. If you want to offer it too, contact us!

## Your complete material selection experience

All product data for your industry vertical, advanced search capacities and direct contact with
suppliers. All in one place. FOR FREE
[Example Image]
INDUSTRY MASTER CATALOG

### Search a catalog that you can trust

SpecialChem maintains the global master catalogs for the following five industry verticals: adhesive
ingredients, coating ingredients, cosmetic ingredients, plastics and elastomers, and polymer
additives. These master catalogs include all products from all suppliers worldwide, making it the
most comprehensive resource available. Product data is sourced directly from manufacturers and
updated daily. Behind the scenes, several dozen chemical experts systematically review every
product, monitor each new release, and track the latest mergers and acquisitions. This ongoing work
ensures that you always have access to the most accurate, up-to-date, and reliable information—so
you can make confident decisions, faster.
[Example Image]
UNIQUE SEARCH CAPACITIES

### Find your products, no matter your criteria

Whether you know exactly what you need, or have rather loose criteria, you can find your way within
SpecialChem master catalogs. Drill down products using up-to 15 dimensions, compare grades, and even
search on a graph! SpecialChem standardizes product data provided by material suppliers, turning it
into convenient filters and search modes. If you need a bit more guidance to achieve a certain
requirement, we can support your material discovery with formalized industry know-how validated by
technical experts.
[Example Image]
CONNECT WITH SUPPLIERS

### Connect with suppliers to get specific recommendations

Hundreds of suppliers are just a click away on the SpecialChem platform. Avoid sending desperate
contact us form into the void. We will connect you with the teams that are truly in charge of the
product portfolio. We know the importance of getting reliable product recommendations to advance
your project.
[Example Image]
GET SAMPLES

### Get samples in few clicks

Tens of thousands of chemicals, ingredients, and materials are available with a sampling option. In
just a few clicks, your sample order is on its way to the supplier. This guarantees you can quickly
resume your product development work. More and more producers and distributors are offering this
option. If you want to offer it too, contact us!

## Our Products

Alfa chemistry offers a variety of surfactants for customers.
* [Anionic Surfactants]
  
  ### Anionic Surfactants
  
  Anionic surfactants are surface actives that ionize negative charges in water. In the production
  of surfactants, anionic surfactants occupy the maximum variety and quantity.
  
  [Product Info >][62]
* [Cationic Surfactants]
  
  ### Cationic Surfactants
  
  Cationic surfactant is a positively charged surfactant and refers to a hydrophilic base whose
  molecules are dissolved in water and attached to a lipophilic base.
  
  [Product Info >][63]
* [Non-ionic Surfactants]
  
  ### Non-ionic Surfactants
  
  Non-ionic surfactants, consisting of a hydrophilic head group and a hydrophobic tail, carry no
  charge and are relatively non-toxic.
  
  [Product Info >][64]
* [Amphoteric Surfactants]
  
  ### Amphoteric Surfactants
  
  Amphoterics are surfactants with ionic charge and they can change between anionic properties, the
  isoelectric neutral stage and the cationic properties depending on the pH value.
  
  [Product Info >][65]
* [Special Surfactants]
  
  ### Special Surfactants
  
  Polymer Surfactants, Silicone Surfactants, Fluoro Surfactants, Natural surfactants.
  
  [Product Info >][66]

  # High quality surfactant products can enrich our life and improve the living environment.
  
  Alfa Chemistry provides you with high quality surfactants and offers full support to meet your
  various demands.

## About Us

[Surfactant]

As a global Contract Research Organization (CRO), headquartered in New York, USA, Alfa Chemistry has
served the pharmaceutical and biotechnology industries for years. Today, Alfa Chemistry is
specialized in organic chemistry, material chemistry, and medicinal chemistry.

[More info > ][61]
* [High Quality]
* High Quality
  
  After years of experience accumulation and technical innovation, we provide high quality
  surfactants to various organizations around the world.
* [Excellent customer service]
* Excellent Customer Service
  
  An excellent sales team & Professional technical staff.
* [Rich Experience]
* Rich Experience
  
  We have dealt with lots of products and our customers are around the world.

## Our Products

Alfa chemistry offers a variety of surfactants for customers.
* [Anionic Surfactants]
  
  ### Anionic Surfactants
  
  Anionic surfactants are surface actives that ionize negative charges in water. In the production
  of surfactants, anionic surfactants occupy the maximum variety and quantity.
  
  [Product Info >][62]
* [Cationic Surfactants]
  
  ### Cationic Surfactants
  
  Cationic surfactant is a positively charged surfactant and refers to a hydrophilic base whose
  molecules are dissolved in water and attached to a lipophilic base.
  
  [Product Info >][63]
* [Non-ionic Surfactants]
  
  ### Non-ionic Surfactants
  
  Non-ionic surfactants, consisting of a hydrophilic head group and a hydrophobic tail, carry no
  charge and are relatively non-toxic.
  
  [Product Info >][64]
* [Amphoteric Surfactants]
  
  ### Amphoteric Surfactants
  
  Amphoterics are surfactants with ionic charge and they can change between anionic properties, the
  isoelectric neutral stage and the cationic properties depending on the pH value.
  
  [Product Info >][65]
* [Special Surfactants]
  
  ### Special Surfactants
  
  Polymer Surfactants, Silicone Surfactants, Fluoro Surfactants, Natural surfactants.
  
  [Product Info >][66]

### [ Surventis launches as an independent global leader in automotive coatings and surface
### treatment ][84]

MUENSTER, Germany, July 1, 2026. Surventis, formerly BASF Coatings, today launched as an independent
company, completing its carve-out from BASF. With around €3.9 billion in annual sales and around
10,700 employees, Surventis is one of the world’s leading suppliers of automotive coatings and
surface treatment solutions. The business is majority-owned by funds managed by global investment
firm Carlyle (NASDAQ: CG) in partnership with Qatar Investment Authority. BASF holds a 40% stake in
Surventis.
Jul 1, 2026

химической продукции от ведущих производителей, предлагая клиентам надежный сервис и эффективные
решения для различных областей промышленности.

удалось создать высокоэффективную цепочку поставок от производителей химических продуктов до
покупателей в России и СНГ.

решения для различных областей промышленности.

# Surfacing knowledge hidden in patents

Great technology solutions are patented.

However, finding and understanding these tech. solutions described in patents can be really
difficult.

So much so, that people don't even bother trying and highly valuable information is missed.

X-ray solves this.

X-ray makes it easy to read and understand the technology solution in the patents.

With X-ray, you innovate fast.

## How is Xray different from a patent database?

**Making patents easier to find**

In patent databases you have to find patents by keyword searching. Xray organizes patents into
categories where patents addressing same problem are already clubbed together. This makes it easy
for you to find patents of your interest.

**Making patents easier to understand**

Xray eliminates legal jargon to make patent language much more easier to understand.

Original Patent Abstract

> A battery system includes: a battery pack including a battery housing and a plurality of battery
> cells accommodated within the battery housing; and a cover element covering an outer side of the
> battery housing. The battery housing has a housing exit at where a venting gas stream exhausted by
> one or more of the battery cells during a thermal runaway exits the battery housing, and the cover
> element covers the housing exit. The cover element forms a venting channel together with the outer
> side of the battery housing such that the venting gas stream exiting the housing exit is received
> and guided by the venting channel along the outer side of the battery housing to a channel exit of
> the venting channel.

Xray Abstract

> Battery system for electric vehicles that has a unique venting system to safely exhaust gases in
> the event of a battery thermal runaway. The system uses a cover element attached to the battery
> pack housing with a venting channel to redirect and cool the hot gases. The channel has obstacles
> and curves to lengthen the path and increase contact with the cover to extract heat. This prevents
> the hot gases from rapidly exiting the pack and potentially igniting, instead cooling them before
> release.

## Why researchers should refer patents?

**Devise solutions faster**

Examining relevant patents sheds light on past attempts to tackle similar issues, helping you
understand the problem better and lower the time to solution.

**Discover new angles**

Related patents show you inventive solutions that might not cross your mind, aiding in
brainstorming, mixing ideas, and improving the ultimate solution you arrive at.

**Feel more confident**

Equipped with a thorough knowledge of the state-of-the-art, which patents provide you with, you
become more confident about your own strategy.

## Why R&D teams fail to benefit from patents?

**Huge datasets**

With ~140,000,000 patents, finding the ones of your interest is a daunting task, requiring expertise
in patent searching most researchers lack.

**Lack of time**

A thorough review can take weeks. Patents are written in heavy techno-legal jargon, which looks
pretty much like a foreign language to non-lawyers.

**Underestimating the value**

**Making patents easier to find**

In patent databases you have to find patents by keyword searching. Xray organizes patents into
categories where patents addressing same problem are already clubbed together. This makes it easy
for you to find patents of your interest.

**Making patents easier to understand**

Xray eliminates legal jargon to make patent language much more easier to understand.

Original Patent Abstract

> A battery system includes: a battery pack including a battery housing and a plurality of battery
> cells accommodated within the battery housing; and a cover element covering an outer side of the
> battery housing. The battery housing has a housing exit at where a venting gas stream exhausted by
> one or more of the battery cells during a thermal runaway exits the battery housing, and the cover
> element covers the housing exit. The cover element forms a venting channel together with the outer
> side of the battery housing such that the venting gas stream exiting the housing exit is received
> and guided by the venting channel along the outer side of the battery housing to a channel exit of
> the venting channel.

Xray Abstract

> Battery system for electric vehicles that has a unique venting system to safely exhaust gases in
> the event of a battery thermal runaway. The system uses a cover element attached to the battery
> pack housing with a venting channel to redirect and cool the hot gases. The channel has obstacles
> and curves to lengthen the path and increase contact with the cover to extract heat. This prevents
> the hot gases from rapidly exiting the pack and potentially igniting, instead cooling them before
> release.

## Why researchers should refer patents?

**Devise solutions faster**

Examining relevant patents sheds light on past attempts to tackle similar issues, helping you
understand the problem better and lower the time to solution.

**Discover new angles**

Related patents show you inventive solutions that might not cross your mind, aiding in
brainstorming, mixing ideas, and improving the ultimate solution you arrive at.

**Feel more confident**

Equipped with a thorough knowledge of the state-of-the-art, which patents provide you with, you
become more confident about your own strategy.

## Why R&D teams fail to benefit from patents?

**Huge datasets**

With ~140,000,000 patents, finding the ones of your interest is a daunting task, requiring expertise
in patent searching most researchers lack.

**Lack of time**

A thorough review can take weeks. Patents are written in heavy techno-legal jargon, which looks
pretty much like a foreign language to non-lawyers.

**Underestimating the value**

"What You See Is All There Is" (WYSIATI) cognitive bias applies to researchers too. Lack of exposure
to patents make them underestimate the value they can provide.
